name: LovedByAI – AI SEO, GEO & AEO for ChatGPT and AI Search, Agentic WooCommerce (ACP, UCP) & WebMCP
author: LovedByAI

sections.description:
LovedByAI is a GEO plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce: generative engine optimization built for small businesses and online stores. It automates the on-page work that helps ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews understand, cite and recommend your site, makes your WooCommerce products available to AI shopping assistants through the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), and reports AI crawler visits and AI referral traffic back to you.

GEO, AEO (answer engine optimization) and AI SEO are three names for the same job: making your pages the source an AI assistant quotes when your customers ask a question. Your existing SEO plugin looks after Google’s blue links. LovedByAI looks after the AI answers, and runs alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress.

What LovedByAI does

  • Automatic, with you in control: every optimization is listed page by page. Review each change, approve or reject it one at a time or all at once, undo it later, and choose whether approved changes go live on your site or stay on the AI-ready version.
  • AI-ready version of every page: builds a structured, plain-language version of each page that AI models can read and quote, linked from your footer.
  • Content matched to the questions people ask: rewrites headings as the questions your customers type into ChatGPT and gives each one a short, quotable answer from your own content.
  • Auto-generated FAQs: writes FAQ sections from your own content, with FAQ schema, in the question-and-answer shape AI answers are built from.
  • Schema (JSON-LD) structured data: adds Organization and FAQPage structured data, and merges into the schema your SEO plugin already outputs instead of duplicating it.
  • Meta titles and meta descriptions: writes clear, entity-rich titles and descriptions that AI search engines and Google can use.
  • Website crawlability check: shows your robots.txt rules beside your server’s live response for every AI crawler, grouped by vendor, so you can see which AI bots are blocked.
  • llms.txt generator: creates /llms.txt if your site does not have one and keeps it up to date. It is a small extra, not the core of the work: AI crawlers rarely request the file, so most of LovedByAI’s effort goes into the content, FAQs and structured data above.
  • IndexNow: pings search engines that support IndexNow, such as Bing, when pages are added or changed.
  • AI agent tools (WebMCP): lets AI agents that browse the web search your site and read your business details, services and products through tools, instead of guessing from the page layout. On by default on paid plans.
  • Agentic commerce for WooCommerce (ACP and UCP): makes your WooCommerce catalog available to AI shopping assistants. A product feed in OpenAI’s Agentic Commerce Protocol format lets ChatGPT show your products with live prices and stock, and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) lets AI shopping agents that use it search your products and read live prices and stock. Paid plans.
  • AI crawler tracking: shows which AI bots visit your site and which pages they read, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, Amazonbot and Meta-ExternalAgent.
  • AI referral traffic analytics: counts the visitors that ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants send you, page by page.
  • Content suggestions: tells you what to publish next and which pages to deepen, based on your site’s own content.
  • Multilingual: finds and optimizes pages in every language of a WPML or Polylang site.

Agentic commerce for WooCommerce stores

When people ask ChatGPT what to buy, the answer comes from product data the assistant can trust: price, stock, images and a link to buy. LovedByAI gives your WooCommerce store that data, with no separate feed plugin.

  • ChatGPT product feed (ACP): your catalog in OpenAI’s product feed format, served from your own domain at a private link. Paste the link into ChatGPT’s merchant portal once.
  • UCP product catalog: publishes your store’s Universal Commerce Protocol profile at /.well-known/ucp, so AI shopping agents that use UCP can search your products and read live prices and stock. Paid plans.
  • Kept current on every save: when you add, edit or delete a product, its feed entry changes in the same moment. A full rebuild runs every day as a safety net.
  • Straight from WooCommerce: title, description, price, stock status, images, brand and weight come from your store as they are.
  • AI agent tools: AI agents shopping for someone can search your products through WebMCP instead of scraping your pages.
  • See what AI sends you: AI crawler visits to your product pages and the shoppers AI assistants refer to your store.

Works alongside your existing Google Shopping or Facebook feed plugin.

Who it is for

Small businesses on WordPress that want to be the name an AI assistant recommends:

  • Local businesses: restaurants, cafes, hotels, tourist attractions, salons, gyms, and home services such as plumbers, electricians and cleaners.
  • Professional firms: lawyers, accountants, doctors, dentists, clinics, real estate agents, financial advisors and IT support companies.
  • Online stores: WooCommerce shops that want their products recommended, priced and linked when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI assistants what to buy.
  • Content sites: bloggers, food bloggers, publishers and niche sites that want their articles cited as sources.

No coding is needed. New and changed pages are optimized automatically, and you can review every change before it goes live.

Get started for free

The plugin works with a free lovedby.ai account. The free tier includes full homepage optimization, AI crawler monitoring, and AI impression and AI visit tracking.
Review the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for more information.

How It Works

  1. Install and connect: Activate the plugin and create your free account.
  2. Optimize: LovedByAI scans your pages and builds the AI-ready versions, FAQs, schema and llms.txt. On a WooCommerce store on a paid plan, it also builds your ACP product feed and UCP profile.
  3. Measure: Watch AI crawler visits, AI impressions and AI referral visits grow in your dashboard.

External services

This is a service plugin. LovedByAI provides an AI/LLM SEO optimization service that requires connection to external servers to function. The plugin acts as a client that connects to the LovedByAI service infrastructure.

Service Description:
LovedByAI is a cloud-based service that optimizes your WordPress website for AI search engines and Large Language Models (LLMs). The service processes your website content, generates optimized machine-readable formats (llms.txt), serves optimized content to AI crawlers, and provides analytics and monitoring capabilities. All processing and data storage occurs on LovedByAI’s cloud infrastructure.

Account Required:
Yes. A free account at lovedby.ai is required to use this plugin. The free tier includes full homepage optimization, bot monitoring, and AI impression and visits tracking.

External Servers Called:

  1. LovedByAI Service Infrastructure

    • API Service (api.lovedby.ai): Core backend API for content optimization, page discovery, and service operations
    • Portal/App Interface (app.lovedby.ai, app.geoguru.ai, portal.geoguru.ai): Service management dashboard and configuration interface
    • CDN (cdn.lovedby.ai, cdn.geoguru.ai): Content delivery network for serving optimized content files
    • Purpose: Core service backend for content optimization, data storage, analytics, and service management interface
    • Data transmitted: Website content (for optimization), configuration settings, analytics data, crawling logs, optimized content files; and, when a post is published, updated or removed, its post id and type, address, status, language, title, a short plain-text excerpt, publish and modified dates, content length, sticky flag, the site’s home address and languages, and change fingerprints (hashes of the post’s fields); and, on WooCommerce stores with the product feed on, the feed’s status: how many products it holds, which products were left out and why, and when it was last fetched. The product feed file itself stays on your server and is read by ChatGPT from your own domain.
    • Terms: https://www.lovedby.ai/terms-of-use
    • Privacy: https://www.lovedby.ai/privacy-policy

  2. Mixpanel

    • Purpose: Analytics tracking for plugin installation and deactivation events only.
    • Data transmitted: Plugin activation/deactivation events (no content data is collected)
    • Terms: https://mixpanel.com/legal/terms-of-use/
    • Privacy: https://mixpanel.com/legal/privacy-policy/

  3. AI shopping agents’ UCP profiles (at the address each calling agent provides)

    • Purpose: When an AI shopping agent calls your store’s UCP catalog, the plugin fetches that agent’s public UCP profile to check which version and capabilities it supports. There is no fixed service, so there is no terms or privacy link.
    • Data transmitted: A plain request carrying your site’s address in WordPress’s standard request header. No customer or visitor data.

Service Management Interface:
The plugin embeds a service management interface (portal app) via iframe for configuration, monitoring, and analytics. This interface is hosted on LovedByAI servers and requires an active account connection.
sections.faq:
What is GEO? Is this a geolocation plugin?

No. GEO here means generative engine optimization: optimizing a website so AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews can understand and cite it. LovedByAI does not detect visitor locations.

What is the difference between GEO, AEO and AI SEO?

They describe the same goal from different angles. GEO (generative engine optimization) and AI SEO focus on being cited in AI-generated answers, and AEO (answer engine optimization) focuses on being the direct answer to a question. LovedByAI covers all three with the same structured content, FAQs and schema.

Does LovedByAI work with WooCommerce?

Yes. LovedByAI optimizes your store’s pages like any other WordPress site, and on paid plans adds agentic commerce: a ChatGPT product feed (ACP), a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) product catalog for AI shopping agents, and AI agent tools for your products. It runs alongside WooCommerce’s own settings and your existing Google Shopping or Facebook feed plugin.

How do I get my WooCommerce products into ChatGPT?

ChatGPT shows products from merchants who give it a product feed. On a paid plan, LovedByAI builds that feed from your WooCommerce catalog in OpenAI’s product feed format and keeps it current as you edit products. Copy the feed link from your LovedByAI dashboard and paste it into ChatGPT’s merchant portal once. OpenAI decides which merchants and products it shows.

What is the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)?

ACP is the open standard OpenAI and Stripe published for selling through ChatGPT. Its product feed tells ChatGPT what a store sells, at what price, and whether it is in stock. LovedByAI builds the ACP product feed for WooCommerce stores.

What is the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)?

UCP is the open standard Google and Shopify introduced so AI agents can discover a store’s products. LovedByAI publishes your WooCommerce store through UCP, so you do not need to set it up yourself.

What are AI agent tools (WebMCP)?

WebMCP is a browser standard that lets a website offer tools to AI agents, such as “search this site” or “list the products”. LovedByAI adds these tools to your site, so an AI agent acting for someone can find your products, services and business details reliably instead of guessing from the page layout.

Does LovedByAI work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Yes. LovedByAI runs alongside your SEO plugin and does not replace it. Its structured data merges into the schema your SEO plugin already outputs instead of adding a duplicate Organization.

I already have schema and an llms.txt file. Will LovedByAI overwrite them?

No. LovedByAI does not overwrite your existing schema or llms.txt. Its structured data merges into the schema your SEO plugin already outputs, and an llms.txt file you already have stays in place.

Does LovedByAI create an llms.txt file?

Yes, if your site does not have one. LovedByAI generates /llms.txt following the llmstxt.org format and keeps it current as you publish. llms.txt is the smallest part of what LovedByAI does, because the evidence that AI assistants use it is weak: across 82 million crawler requests to WordPress sites between December 2025 and May 2026, AI bots fetched an llms.txt file 31 times (LovedByAI llms.txt study). Being cited depends far more on clear content, FAQs, structured data and crawler access, which is where LovedByAI does most of its work.

Can I see which AI crawlers visit my site and how much traffic AI sends me?

Yes. The dashboard lists the AI bots that crawl your site and the pages they read, and counts visits referred by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants, per page.

What do I need to get started?

Install the plugin and register a free account at lovedby.ai.

Does LovedByAI change my content or design?

Only with your approval. LovedByAI optimizes automatically, but every change is listed for review: approve it, reject it or undo it later. By default it publishes a separate AI-ready version of each page and leaves the page your visitors see as it is, and you choose whether approved changes go live on your site.

Does it slow down my website?

No. Processing happens on LovedByAI’s cloud infrastructure, not on your server, and tracking runs asynchronously so it does not delay page loads. The WooCommerce product feed is rebuilt in the background, never while a visitor waits.

Does this replace traditional SEO?

No. It complements it. Traditional SEO targets search results pages, and LovedByAI targets AI assistants and AI Overviews. Using both covers both places people search.

Does it work on multilingual sites?

Yes. Pages in every language of a WPML or Polylang site are found and optimized, including translations served at the same address with a ?lang= parameter.

Can you guarantee a citation in ChatGPT?

No tool can guarantee rankings or citations, because AI models decide independently which sources to quote and which products to show. LovedByAI makes your pages and products clearer and easier for AI models to read and cite, and measures what happens.
sections.changelog:
2.9.1

  • Removing flagged pages: when the WordPress trash is turned off, pages are no longer offered for removal, so nothing is ever deleted for good. Pages already in the trash are recognised, and one unusual address no longer stops the rest from being found.

2.9.0

  • Remove pages flagged as not belonging to your site, straight from the dashboard. Pages go to the WordPress trash, so they can be restored for 30 days. The home page, the blog page, the privacy page and store pages are never removed.

2.8.4

  • WebMCP: a tool that takes no inputs now publishes a valid input schema, with an empty object for its properties instead of an empty list.

2.8.3

  • UCP catalog search: when the store’s search finds no exact match, products whose titles name more of the search words now come first, so a search like “2 inch lift kit yukon” no longer leads with unrelated products.

2.8.2

  • UCP catalog image and product links are valid web addresses even when a file name holds characters like ™.
  • Page caches no longer keep the UCP catalog address, so switching UCP on or off, a plan change, or another plugin publishing it takes effect at once. Whenever UCP is switched, the plan changes or the plugin is activated or deactivated, the address is cleared from LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache and WP Super Cache.

2.8.1

  • Improvements to upcoming AI agent features.

2.8.0

  • WooCommerce stores on a paid plan publish a UCP product catalog at /.well-known/ucp. AI agents must identify themselves with a UCP profile, and the store fetches that public profile to check it. It steps aside if another plugin already provides one.

2.7.0

  • WooCommerce stores on a paid plan get a ChatGPT product feed in OpenAI’s Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) format, kept current as products change. You can turn it off in the plugin settings.

2.6.3

  • Detects whether the site runs an online store.

2.6.2

  • AI agent tools and AI visit tracking load right away on sites that use a JavaScript delay plugin, instead of waiting for the visitor to scroll or click.

2.6.1

  • AI agent tools are on by default.

2.6.0

  • Pages your SEO plugin marks noindex are detected without fetching each page.

2.5.5

  • Groundwork for upcoming AI agent features. Off by default.

2.5.4

  • Removed unused code.

2.5.3

  • Minor internal cleanup of how the plugin connects to its service.

2.5.2

  • Your dashboard notices a plugin update sooner.

2.5.1

  • Pages you unpublish, password-protect, trash or delete stop being served in their optimized form.

2.5.0

  • New and edited posts and pages reach your dashboard within minutes.
  • Pages you unpublish, password-protect, trash or delete leave your llms.txt.
  • Browsers and caches now refresh your llms.txt within an hour.

2.4.2

  • Minor fixes to how the plugin is listed on the Plugins page.

2.4.1

  • Fixed the AI visit tracking endpoint answering some malformed requests with a server error (500). They are now rejected with a 400.

2.4.0

  • Your dashboard can now use an article’s featured image when it suggests sharing the article on Pinterest.
  • Improvements and fixes to the recommendations in your dashboard.

2.3.2

  • Fixed plugin requests being blocked on sites that require a login for the REST API when the request URL encodes its route.
  • Security hardening.

2.3.1

  • Fixed the footer link to the AI version page reloading the same page on sites where Yoast SEO removes unregistered URL parameters.

2.3.0

  • Pages in every language of a WPML or Polylang site, and public content types that are hidden from the WordPress REST API, can now be found and optimized.
  • A translation served at the same address as its original plus ?lang= now gets its own optimized version instead of sharing the original’s.

2.2.3

  • Structured data now merges into an existing Organization when another plugin wraps its schema in a list, instead of adding a second one.
  • Fixed structured data merging when a page’s schema graph holds a single item instead of a list.

2.2.2

  • Fixed the footer link to the AI version page collapsing into a narrow column of single words on some themes.

2.2.1

  • The plugin menu now reads “Home” and “Advanced Settings” instead of “Overview” and “Settings”.

2.2.0

  • Your dashboard can now suggest what to publish next, and which pages to deepen, based on your site’s own content.
  • Suggestions to share your newest content now include case studies, projects and other content types, not only blog posts.

2.1.0

  • New sites no longer apply optimizations to the page itself until that is turned on. The AI version page is unchanged.

2.0.1

  • AI visit reports now record whether the requested page exists, so visits to missing pages can be identified.

2.0.0

  • You can now control, per site, how optimizations are delivered to the canonical page and to the AI version page.
  • Content changes you have approved can now be applied to the page itself, not only to the AI version page.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
